name: HTB Certified Active Directory Pentesting Expert

third_party_evaluations.summary: Advanced AD attacks: Kerberos/NTLM abuse, ADCS, WSUS, Exchange, trust abuse.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 1, specialty: 2. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded hands-on depth across AD trust and authentication attacks establishes a focused directory-security specialization; the four-year profile and domain concentration do not equate to broad expert direction.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded fully practical assessment of ADCS, trust abuse, Kerberos and related enterprise attacks supports expert offensive depth. The four-year profile is below the usual expert range, but senior rigor and the stored advanced scope outweigh that limitation.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded fully practical AD assessment reaches Kerberos, ADCS, Exchange and trust abuse in substantial depth. This is an advanced directory-specific branch of pentesting, so specialty conveys its scope better than a universal expert rank.
